title: Delhi HC: Writ Petition Will Not Lie Against LinkedIn Over Account Restriction
case_name: Mayank Jain v. Union of India and Others
card_summary: Justice Amit Mahajan dismissed a writ petition challenging LinkedIn's restriction of a user's account, holding that the platform performs no public function and is not amenable to writ jurisdiction under Article 226. The court said the proper remedy is a civil suit against the platform, not a writ petition, following its earlier reasoning in a similar case against X Corp.
card_tip: A user whose account is suspended or restricted by a private platform such as LinkedIn cannot approach the High Court by writ. The remedy is a civil suit against the platform, not a petition under Article 226.
